title: surface-input fallback step detail
tests: fallback tests keep their contains() assertions and pass unchanged.
description:
Owner bug report 2026-11-13: a default-grade GPU export fell
back with reason=surface-input-unavailable and the log could not
say WHICH bring-up step failed — the Surface creation, the EGL
wrap, or the recordable query. The diagnosis needs the step, the
line named only the category.

The fallback reason now names the failing step. MediaCodecMp4Writer
throws every surface-input failure with its SurfaceInputStep (a new
closed JVM-side vocabulary in SurfaceInputUnavailable.kt — the
native seam never throws this, so no JNI mapping is needed): the
writer's own mode, the M5 session mode, and the adopt fallback all
report egl-display, egl-init, egl-config, egl-context, codec-create,
codec-config, create-input-surface, egl-wrap, egl-current,
presentation-time-ext, blit-shader, blit-program, codec-start.
The exporter appends the step's token to the SAME one-line reason:
reason=surface-input-unava
changed: fix: name surface-input fallback step in reason
